name: Git Starter Kit
release_notes: Replace the removed npm patch/verify commands with the audit command and use the bundled current updater for schema 4 upgrade packages.
Keep consumer readonly validation free of filesystem writes and reject executable interpolation or PowerShell requirements in sealed workflows.
Preserve concurrent user edits, prevent archive overwrites, and report oversized JSON input through controlled errors.
Align optional automation prerequisites and changelog formatting with the repository contracts, and refresh the locked quality toolchain.
